reviewer: single independent sequential reviewer; no delegation
scope: Six candidates independently, original README/source contract; each candidate host.go/host_test.go/go.mod/README.md exact hashes.
exclusions: Repository planning/results, identities/profiles/reports/other reviewers; outside packet host/deployment/threat context; no comparison or promotion verdict.
contract: original/README.md; held and supplementary fixtures explicit bounded worker contract observations, not universal Go requirements or proof.
